summary: lineinfile options: owner, required path, regexp (last match replaced; should match before and after for idempotence), and search_string for literal matching.
questions: How do I make lineinfile idempotent with regexp?
How do I match a literal string without regex escaping?
How do I remove all lines matching a pattern?
Which line gets replaced if several match?

answer_card.title: lineinfile regexp and search_string
answer_card.answer_md:
- `path` (required; aliases `dest`, `destfile`, `name`)
- `regexp` (alias `regex`): for `present`, last matching line replaced; for `absent`, all matching lines removed. Should match the line both before and after change for idempotence.
- `search_string`: literal substring match (no escaping); excludes `regexp`/`backrefs`
- `owner`
